key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/diskfont.library:3:025C
name: return_zero_stub
description: Library code that returns zero and performs no operations on registers, memory, or hardware.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/diskfont.library:5:0000
name: scan_font_file_into_table
description: Opens a font file through the dos library and counts its records, then allocates a table and copies the records that carry a matching type code into it. It returns the table, or nothing when a step fails, and releases its locks and buffers on the way out.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/diskfont.library:5:00BA
name: build_font_table_from_directory
description: Walks a directory with examine and next-entry calls to find font entries, allocates a table with a header and count, and copies each matching entry's name and metrics into it. It returns the table pointer, or nothing on failure, and frees its temporary blocks and lock.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/diskfont.library:5:0240
name: release_stored_size_block
description: Reads the size stored just before the given block and passes the block and that size to the exec library's free-memory call. It does no other work.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/diskfont.library:1:0000
name: call_unknown_handler
description: Calls another routine whose target cannot be identified from this code, then returns. It adds no work of its own.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/diskfont.library:1:0012
name: call_external_handler
description: Calls a routine reached through a pointer and then returns, with no other work.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/diskfont.library:1:001E
name: relay_handler_call
description: Calls one further routine and returns, passing nothing new on.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/diskfont.library:1:002C
name: forward_handler_call
description: Calls another routine and then returns without additional operations.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:0000
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decodes to a single unimplemented instruction marker, so it contains no usable behaviour. It is undecodable data rather than a working routine.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:008A
name: setup_math_library_context
description: Calls an exec library function, and if it succeeds and a library base is present, allocates a context block through the exec library. It then fills the block's handler pointers and fields from the library state and makes one more library call.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:00B6
name: init_math_context_from_resource
description: Looks up the MathIEEE resource through a library call unless a flag bit is set, then allocates a context block, fills its handler pointers and fields, and makes one more library call to finish. The resource address is stored in the block.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:00E4
name: allocate_math_context_block
description: Allocates a context block through the exec library, sets its handler pointers, and stores the supplied values in its fields. It then makes one more library call and returns.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:034C
name: raise_exception_for_code
description: Masks the low word of a data register and compares it against two specific codes. One code triggers a deliberate division by zero, the other a trap-on-overflow instruction, and any other value returns without action.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:0368
name: check_exception_code_in_bands
description: Returns early unless the low word lies in one of two narrow bands. Inside those bands it applies the same two code checks as its neighbours, raising a division trap or an overflow trap for the matching codes.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:0370
name: check_exception_code_low_range
description: Applies the two code checks only for values at or below a threshold or inside an upper band, and returns without action for all other values.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:0378
name: check_exception_code_upper_band
description: Applies the two code checks only when the low word falls within one upper band, returning without action for other values.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:0380
name: check_exception_code_under_limit
description: Applies the two code checks only when the low word is at or below an upper limit, and returns for any larger value.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:0388
name: stub_return_only
description: Consists only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use. It does no work.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:038A
name: poll_status_and_store_value
description: Polls a status word in a buffer structure until it leaves a marker state, stores a 32-bit value taken from the argument pair, and writes two fixed control words into the structure. Its purpose is not clear from this code alone.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:03AA
name: wait_status_then_return_value
description: Stores a 32-bit value from the arguments, waits for the status word in the buffer structure to become non-negative, writes a control word, and returns the stored value. The purpose of the control words is not evident from this code alone.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:03CE
name: poll_status_and_return_value
description: Waits on a status word in a buffer structure, calls an unnamed routine for each non-marker value, writes a fixed control word, and returns the stored value.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:0964
name: transfer_two_pairs_with_status
description: Writes two pairs of 32-bit arguments through a buffer structure in stages, writing a series of control words and polling the status word between steps. It returns the last stored value as a 64-bit result.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:0986
name: send_five_args_with_status
description: Writes five 32-bit arguments through a buffer structure in stages, interleaving control words with status polls. It returns the stored 64-bit value at the end.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:09B0
name: send_arg_pair_with_status
description: Writes a pair of arguments through a buffer structure, writing control words and polling for status, then returns the stored value.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:09E4
name: drain_status_and_return_stored
description: Waits for the status word to clear while calling an unnamed routine for each non-marker value, writes a fixed control word, and returns the stored long.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:09F6
name: return_constant_zero
description: Returns zero unconditionally, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:18F8
name: evaluate_exponential_double
description: Computes a double-precision exponential-type result: it returns one for zero input, otherwise scales the exponent by a fixed reciprocal-of-logarithm constant and evaluates a polynomial with fixed coefficients. Out-of-range inputs take a separate return path.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:195A
name: evaluate_exponential_from_frame
description: Companion of the neighbouring exponential-type evaluator: it reads its double argument from a stack-frame structure, applies the same scaling and polynomial steps with its own fixed coefficients, and returns the double result.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:1980
name: evaluate_double_kernel_short
description: A shorter variant of the same double-precision kernel: it takes its argument from a stack-frame structure, runs a few multiply-and-add steps with fixed coefficients, and returns a double result.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:19AA
name: evaluate_double_kernel_long
description: A long double-precision kernel that reads its argument from a stack-frame structure, applies range reduction, and runs a long sequence of multiply-and-add calls with fixed coefficients before returning the double result.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:1CFA
name: adjust_double_exponent_checked
description: Adds an integer to the exponent field of a double-precision value. It returns zero when the result underflows and a saturated large value when it overflows, otherwise the scaled value.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:1D2A
name: adjust_double_exponent_fast
description: Adds an integer to the exponent field of a double-precision value and returns the result. It saturates to a large value on overflow but does not check for underflow.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:1D36
name: set_double_exponent_field
description: Replaces the exponent field of a double-precision value with one derived from the argument and returns the result, leaving the mantissa unchanged.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:1D6C
name: compute_logarithm_double_small
description: Computes a natural logarithm for a double-precision argument. It returns zero for zero or negative input, otherwise it reduces the value against a fixed square-root-of-two bound, applies a polynomial with fixed coefficients, and adds the logarithm of two.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:1D94
name: evaluate_logarithm_double_full
description: A large double-precision logarithm kernel that reduces its argument against fixed bounds and applies a long polynomial with fixed coefficients, calling unnamed routines at each step and returning the double result.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:358C
name: compute_double_power
description: Raises a double-precision base to a double exponent. It returns one when the exponent is zero, and otherwise combines the logarithm and exponential unnamed routines with separate handling of sign and zero cases.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:35D6
name: compute_power_alternate_path
description: A second power routine for the same double base and exponent arguments, with its own sign and zero checks and a series-based path for small exponents.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:364A
name: return_double_one
description: Stores zero in the low part and returns the double-precision value one, with no calls or hardware access.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:364E
name: compute_power_integer_exponent
description: Raises a double-precision value to an integer exponent. It takes the absolute value of the exponent, multiplies the value in small steps for small exponents, and calls a separate unnamed routine for larger ones.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:3704
name: compute_power_integer_partials
description: Continues the integer-exponent power calculation with the same absolute-value and small-count loop as its neighbour, multiplying partial results together and calling the multiply unnamed routine on each step.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:374A
name: repeat_multiply_steps_count
description: Calls an unnamed routine repeatedly for a count held in a register, passing the partial result back each time through a stack-frame value, then stores the final pair. It is a loop of repeated step calls.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:377A
name: combine_even_odd_power_steps
description: Splits a repeated-multiplication count into odd and even parts, combining partial products through unnamed routine calls. It returns the final double value.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:3810
name: guard_and_forward_math_call
description: Returns zero when the first argument is zero or fails a sign check. Otherwise it forwards four arguments to a handler reached through a pointer and returns that handler's result.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:3826
name: forward_math_call_four_args
description: Forwards four arguments to a handler reached through a pointer and returns its double-precision result.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:39E6
name: stub_return_zero_value
description: Returns zero with no calls, memory access or hardware register use.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:3AA8
name: chain_three_math_calls
description: Passes its two arguments to one unnamed routine, then feeds each result into the next unnamed routine in turn, returning the final double-precision value.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:3B2C
name: clear_or_rebias_double_exponent
description: Treats the value at a pointer as a double-precision number. If its exponent is below a lower bound it clears all four words to zero, otherwise it rewrites the exponent field with a biased value.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:3B56
name: rebias_double_exponent_field
description: Replaces the exponent field of the double-precision value at a pointer with a biased value from a register, leaving the sign and mantissa bits in place.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:3B70
name: dispatch_via_table_offset
description: Calls a routine found at an offset from the stored library base pointer, with the offset supplied in a register. It dispatches to a function in the library's jump table.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:3B90
name: call_library_slot_a
description: Calls a library function at a fixed offset from the stored library base pointer and returns.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:3B98
name: call_library_slot_b
description: Calls a second library function at a different fixed offset from the stored library base pointer and returns.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:3BA0
name: call_library_slot_c
description: Calls a third library function at another fixed offset from the stored library base pointer and returns.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:3BA8
name: call_library_slot_d
description: Calls a library function at a fixed offset from the stored library base pointer, then returns.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:3BB0
name: call_library_slot_e
description: Calls a further library function at another fixed offset from the stored library base pointer, with no other work.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:3BD8
name: dispatch_via_register_offset
description: Calls a routine located at an offset from the stored base pointer, with the offset taken from a register. It dispatches through the library's table.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:3BE8
name: call_library_slot_f
description: Calls a library function at a fixed offset from the stored base pointer and returns.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:3BF0
name: call_library_slot_g
description: Calls another library function at a fixed offset from the stored base pointer and returns.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:3BF8
name: call_mathieee_basic_slot_a
description: Calls a function in the mathieeedoubbas library through a fixed table offset and returns.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:libs/mathieeedoubtrans.library:0:3C10
name: call_mathieee_basic_slot_b
description: Calls a second function in the mathieeedoubbas library through a different fixed table offset and returns.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:0000
name: open_system_libraries_at_start
description: Program entry point: it opens the dos, graphics and intuition libraries through the exec library, allocates a memory block, and uses task and message-port calls bracketed by forbid and permit calls before continuing.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:010A
name: close_file_and_free_resources
description: Tears down a file and its resources: it closes the file, closes a library, frees a memory block and replies to a message, walking a linked list of pending items on the way.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:0196
name: build_and_send_request_block
description: Builds a request on the stack, has the library fill it in, allocates a block with fixed flags and stores the supplied value in it, then sends the block through the library and returns a status.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:0282
name: store_args_in_global_slots
description: Copies its two arguments and one stack value into fixed slots of the program's global data area, then returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:0292
name: release_slots_if_set
description: Releases two stored resources when they are set: it frees a block when one slot is non-zero and calls a library close function when the other slot is not the sentinel value, then returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:02C8
name: stub_return_zero_status
description: Returns zero without any calls or memory access.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:02D2
name: close_and_reset_request_block
description: Calls a library function on a stored handle when it is set, resets two fields to a sentinel value, makes a further library call, and then calls the release unnamed routine on the structure. It returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:033A
name: call_handle_function_zero
description: Calls a function through a handle stored in its argument structure, then returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:0360
name: forward_fixed_code_argument
description: Passes a fixed code value and its argument on to a unnamed routine and returns.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:038C
name: allocate_flagged_block_when_set
description: When its second argument is non-zero, allocates a memory block with fixed flags and writes a type byte and a short value into its header. It then returns the block.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:0412
name: return_frame_slot_value
description: Returns the word-sized value stored at a fixed offset in the current stack frame, with no calls or memory access.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:041E
name: reset_and_release_record
description: When given a record, sets three of its fields to a sentinel value, passes the record to a release unnamed routine, and returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:0462
name: initialise_empty_list_head
description: Sets up an empty linked-list header by pointing its first link at the following word, clearing the count, and making the last link point back to the header. Returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:048E
name: initialise_large_stack_buffers
description: Reserves a very large stack frame made of many byte buffers and calls unnamed routines that use them. The purpose of each buffer cannot be determined from this code alone.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:05F8
name: load_executable_hunks_with_prompt
description: Walks the hunk records of an executable read from disk, comparing each record's type code against the AmigaDOS hunk identifiers and dispatching it to an unnamed routine. A prompt string about the end of a turn is referenced in its data.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:1112
name: open_screen_and_load_pictures
description: Sets up the display: it creates a directory, opens files and a screen through the dos and intuition libraries, sets the font and colour table, and loads the named picture and font resources before returning.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:19F2
name: release_loaded_display_resources
description: Releases the display resources it holds, closing a font, unlocking a file lock and freeing several stored blocks. Any slot that is empty is skipped.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:1B48
name: query_two_values_and_forward
description: Makes two library queries, then passes their results together with a global value to an unnamed routine twice, and returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:1BB2
name: draw_bitmap_and_text_panel
description: Large drawing routine: it blits bitmap regions to the rastport, using masks where needed, measures text width, and formats a string containing a name and a number before drawing it.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:2EEE
name: build_turn_event_messages
description: Builds formatted turn-event messages from fixed text fragments, covering famine, starvation, new colonists, lava destruction and volcanic eruptions for a named place. Each message is passed on for display.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:4D1A
name: scan_window_for_matching_entries
description: Scans a fixed window of fixed-size table records, comparing a word field with a stored value and testing a second condition on each match. It returns once the search range is exhausted.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:4EF8
name: draw_tax_and_city_status
description: Draws labels and formatted values for the tax rate and city totals in the status panel, scanning a table of map entries on the way.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:5188
name: draw_unit_info_panel
description: Draws unit information: formatted tonnage and percentage values, moves and hit points, plus masked bitmap blits for the icon, and then calls unnamed routines for the rest of the panel.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:57C0
name: read_grid_byte_at
description: Returns one byte from a grid of 64-byte rows, selected by the row and column arguments.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:57F4
name: compose_three_call_results
description: Calls one unnamed routine with its last two arguments, passes that result with the first argument to a second unnamed routine, then feeds the result to a third unnamed routine and returns it.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:5832
name: write_grid_byte_at
description: Stores a byte value into a grid of 64-byte rows at the given row and column, then returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:5862
name: combine_four_args_via_calls
description: Combines four arguments through two unnamed routine calls, passes the first result to a third unnamed routine, and returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:589E
name: wrap_grid_index
description: Wraps a row or column index into the range of a 64-entry grid by adding or subtracting the grid size once when it falls outside.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:58DE
name: initialise_map_and_name_tables
description: Clears the 1024-entry map table and nine record slots, then fills them with the lists of place and building names referenced in its data.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:6FA4
name: find_best_candidate_cell
description: Sets a group of best-so-far values to a sentinel and scans the map table for a candidate cell, keeping the best one found. The exact criterion is not fully clear from this code.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:7062
name: set_flag_bits_index_table
description: Sets bit patterns in four stack bytes, then indexes a table with a value from a register and updates a field of the record. Its wider purpose is not clear from this fragment.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:70CE
name: scan_cells_for_matching_field
description: Scans the 1024-entry map table, comparing a word field of each cell with the same field of the currently selected cell, and records the matches it finds.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:72FE
name: scan_cells_matching_field_b
description: Continues the map-table scan with the same field comparison, advancing through the table and calling an unnamed routine on each match.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:7306
name: validate_city_conquest_order
description: Checks whether the selected unit may attack or conquer a target city, scanning the map table for it. It shows refusal messages such as that only armed units may conquer cities, then performs the conquest steps when allowed.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:80D8
name: evaluate_action_eligibility
description: Checks a per-unit status word and a map cell field, returning a value that says whether the requested action is allowed. It calls unnamed routines to set the result flag.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:8334
name: dispatch_input_by_screen_region
description: Decides which action an input code selects by testing a pointer position against a set of screen rectangles, and then dispatches the matching action. The input code is compared with a fixed value first.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:890C
name: draw_production_menu_panel
description: Draws the production and unit command panel, listing unit and building options such as Settler, Colonist and Trade Wagon with their costs, and shows commands such as Join Colony and Load/Unload Cargo. It blits the matching icons and the message for places where no production is possible.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:AF0C
name: draw_map_tile_overlays
description: Scans the map table and draws masked bitmap overlays for the entries that match the current filter, using the mask blit call.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:B326
name: draw_resource_counts_panel
description: Draws the lumber and tools counts for a selected item as formatted text, or the word Nothing when none is present, using masked blits for the panel.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:B5E4
name: draw_numbered_slot_grid
description: Draws a grid of eight slots, each with a three-digit number label in a fixed format, placing them at offsets computed from the slot index.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:B6EE
name: find_free_table_slot
description: Searches the 1024-entry table for the first record whose field is zero and returns its index, or the sentinel value when no record is free.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:B908
name: prompt_disband_confirmation
description: Shows a confirmation dialog offering to disband the selected unit, with the choices Disband it! and Don't disband, and returns the choice made.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:BC1C
name: prompt_yes_no_confirmation
description: Presents a two-option confirmation with the labels No, just kidding and Yes, let it go!, and returns the selected result.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:BCBC
name: forward_stored_argument_return_zero
description: Passes a stored argument to a unnamed routine and returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:BCD0
name: sum_square_neighbourhood
description: Loops over a square neighbourhood of cells around a centre position, reads a value for each cell through an unnamed routine, and combines the results.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:BD7E
name: draw_map_view_section
description: Draws a section of the map view by blitting tile bitmaps to the rastport with masks where needed. It computes each position from the map table and calls several unnamed routines to choose the tiles.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:C8EC
name: allocate_bitmap_planes
description: Allocates a bitmap structure and its raster planes through the graphics library, initialising each plane in turn, and returns the result.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:C9CC
name: free_bitmap_planes
description: Frees the raster planes of a bitmap structure one at a time through the graphics library, then releases the structure itself. It does nothing when the structure is missing.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:CA84
name: reset_grid_cell_states
description: Walks every position of a 64 by 64 grid, resetting each cell's state through unnamed routine calls.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:CDB2
name: relax_grid_until_stable
description: Repeatedly sweeps a 64 by 64 grid, adjusting cells through unnamed routine calls, until a full sweep makes no further changes.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:CF20
name: find_matching_table_entry
description: Reads a stored field of a cell, searches the table for an entry with a matching value, and returns the position it finds.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:CFB8
name: update_four_neighbour_cells
description: Visits the four neighbouring cells of a position through unnamed routine calls. When the reference index is missing it applies a fixed update instead.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:D0FE
name: sweep_neighbour_offsets
description: Sweeps a small square neighbourhood of offsets around a cell, calling an unnamed routine for each position, and returns its last result.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:D106
name: scan_neighbour_row_offsets
description: Scans one row of neighbouring offsets around a cell, calling an unnamed routine for each position in the row.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:D10E
name: scan_entries_matching_field
description: Scans the 64-entry table, comparing a word field of each record with a stored value, and calls an unnamed routine for every record that matches.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:D1CA
name: prompt_city_name_entry
description: Checks a unit's type code. For one special code it takes a default path, otherwise it asks what to call the new city and passes the answer on.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:D488
name: clear_record_word_slots
description: Zeroes a block of 24 word-sized fields in the selected record, then calls an unnamed routine to refresh it.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:D4C2
name: call_two_routines_return_zero
description: Calls two unnamed routines with the stored values and returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:D4DA
name: check_city_site_not_marketplace
description: Checks whether the selected unit's position is a marketplace. If it is, it reports that a city cannot be built there, otherwise it continues the city-site check.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:D51C
name: check_city_site_distance
description: Tests the distance from the proposed site to existing cities before a build is allowed. When the site is too close, it reports that a city cannot be built here and names the nearby place.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:D5A8
name: reject_city_site_near_enemy
description: Reports that a city cannot be built at the chosen site because an enemy city is too close, using two message calls, and returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:D5DE
name: send_fixed_status_message
description: Passes a fixed code and a global text reference to a unnamed routine and returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:D5FE
name: report_city_build_refusal
description: Reports that a city cannot be built on a named location, placing the location name into the message, and returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:D64C
name: draw_masked_city_icon
description: Draws a masked bitmap icon for a map entry through the graphics library, at a position computed from fixed offsets.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:D844
name: draw_offset_rectangle_pair
description: Draws two rectangles through an unnamed routine, the second placed at an offset from the first, using positions computed from its arguments.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:D8FC
name: run_timed_animation_step
description: Runs one timed animation step: it computes positions from its argument, draws shapes through unnamed routines, and pauses with the dos delay call.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:DDAC
name: draw_cell_highlight_frame
description: Draws a frame at a position derived from the column argument, choosing one of two colour indexes according to a flag, then calls a second unnamed routine.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:DE64
name: run_timed_display_sequence
description: Runs a longer timed display sequence, computing positions from its arguments, calling unnamed routines to draw each step, and pausing with the dos delay call between steps.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:E384
name: draw_cell_frame_variant
description: Draws a frame at a position computed from the row argument, choosing between two colour indexes by a flag, then calls a second unnamed routine.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:E4A2
name: prompt_irreversible_choice
description: Asks a two-option question with the labels No, that would be folly and Yes, it's My will. When the answer is yes it passes the selected entry on to an unnamed routine.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:E55E
name: draw_masked_bitmap_at_offset
description: Draws a masked bitmap at a position offset from the first arguments, using the graphics mask blit call.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:E6E8
name: update_record_derived_fields
description: Recalculates several fields of a table record in place, using values read from the table and unnamed routine calls.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:F1E2
name: test_grid_bit_mask
description: Returns the result of combining a stored mask word with a byte read from a grid cell, with the cell chosen by the row and column arguments.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:F252
name: compact_record_slot_list
description: Compacts a 32-slot list in a record by moving filled entries toward the start and skipping empty markers.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:F316
name: compact_six_slot_list
description: Compacts a six-slot list in a record by moving filled entries toward the start and skipping empty markers.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:F3C2
name: check_building_placement_rules
description: Validates a building placement in a city. It refuses with a message when a second ironworks or shipyard would be added, or when nothing can be built on that site, and otherwise continues the build.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:FEB4
name: build_main_menu_entries
description: Builds the menu structure for the main menu bar, with the Game, Player, View and About menus and items such as Load, Save, Quit, Declare war, Declare peace, Find city and Show Hidden Terrain.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:1036A
name: fill_empty_table_record
description: Fills in a table record whose first field is zero through a sequence of unnamed routine calls, after checking a field's value.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:10560
name: forward_record_value_when_clear
description: When a flag in a table record is clear, passes a stored value from that record to a unnamed routine, as one step of a larger check.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:1065C
name: report_duplicate_occupant
description: Shows the message that the place already holds an occupant, naming that place in the text.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:106C8
name: find_entry_by_type_code
description: Searches the 64-entry table for the first record whose type field equals the given value, and returns its index, or minus one when none matches.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:107AC
name: run_cargo_transfer_dialog
description: Handles loading and unloading cargo between a unit and a city or ship. It asks how much to load or unload, reports when no free cargo bays remain, and redraws the affected panels.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:119EC
name: draw_eight_digit_readout
description: Draws a value in a fixed three-digit format through masked blits, repeating for eight digit positions.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:11BE6
name: draw_five_digit_readout
description: Draws a value in a fixed three-digit format through masked blits, repeating for five positions.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:11DAA
name: draw_bounded_value_selector
description: Formats a bounded range of values as a low-to-high text pair and draws a selection panel with it, calling unnamed routines for the layout.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:12456
name: draw_value_selector_panel
description: Draws a panel for choosing a value within a range, using the same text and blit routines as its neighbour, and calls unnamed routines for the layout.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:12B4E
name: clear_and_draw_centered_text
description: Clears a rectangular area, measures a text string's width, and draws the text centred within the area. It then calls unnamed routines for the remaining drawing.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:12E30
name: clear_and_blit_panel_region
description: Clears a rastport region and copies a bitmap into it with the blit call, drawing one panel frame for the display.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:13124
name: compare_entry_fields_and_act
description: Reads two fields of a table record, compares them through unnamed routine calls, and applies the result to the record. The full comparison is not clear from the visible code.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:13340
name: test_special_flag_entry
description: Tests whether a table entry's field matches a special value and whether the twelfth entry matches, returning a combined true or false result for the caller.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:13420
name: prompt_player_setup
description: Asks how many players take part, then prompts for a name for each player, filling the player records with the entered names and default values.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:13942
name: announce_war_declaration
description: Shows the message that one side declares war on another, naming both sides, and passes the text on to an unnamed routine.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:13A66
name: announce_peace_treaty
description: When a peace flag is clear, shows the message that one side will sign a peace treaty with the other, naming both sides.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:13B60
name: prompt_break_treaty_choice
description: Shows a choice between Break treaty and Cancel action, naming the treaty partner, and returns the selected result.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:13BDE
name: find_best_entry_pair
description: Scans the 64-entry table for a record that matches its two arguments, keeps the best candidate found, and returns its index.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:13DF0
name: update_record_from_arguments
description: Stores its arguments into stack slots and calls unnamed routines to update a record, returning a status. Its exact effect is not clear from this fragment.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:14138
name: run_eight_step_accumulation
description: Runs an eight-step loop that starts from a value of one hundred and combines values from the records through unnamed routine calls. The loop includes checks against AmigaDOS hunk type codes.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:14468
name: set_unit_build_costs
description: Sets the build costs for the selected unit type, described in arms and horses, through unnamed routine calls.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:14634
name: set_cavalry_or_colonist_production
description: When the selected unit has a particular type code, sets a production flag and calls unnamed routines to show the cavalry or colonist production choice.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:1470E
name: set_infantry_or_colonist_production
description: When the selected unit has a particular type code, sets a production flag and calls unnamed routines to present the infantry or colonist choice.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:14870
name: update_unit_field_for_type
description: When the unit has one of two type codes and the related record matches, updates a field of that record. Otherwise it leaves the field alone.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:14936
name: copy_unit_field_type_three
description: When the unit has type code three, copies a field value between two table records.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:14AA8
name: compute_entry_pair_result
description: Reads a field from two table entries, combines them through unnamed routine calls, and returns the result. Its use is not fully clear from the visible code.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:14BEE
name: set_special_unit_type_field
description: For unit type codes three, nine and ten, sets a field of the record to a value and calls unnamed routines to update it.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:14C72
name: report_irrigation_refusal
description: Shows the message that land with buildings on it cannot be irrigated, then returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:14C94
name: save_game_to_slot_file
description: Prompts for a description of the game, writes the game state to a numbered save file, and reports either that the game was saved or that the file could not be opened.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:152BA
name: load_game_from_slot_file
description: Opens a numbered save file, reads the saved game state back, and reports either that the game loaded or that the slot is empty.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:15826
name: read_save_slot_label
description: Opens a numbered save file to read its label, showing the empty-slot text when the file is missing, and returns the label.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:15966
name: open_playsnd_audio_port
description: Opens a message port for sound playback through the exec library, referring to the audio device, and sends a sound request through unnamed routine calls.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:15A38
name: load_numbered_sound_sample
description: Builds a sample file name from a number, opens and reads the file through the dos library, and passes the data to an unnamed routine before returning the result.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:15B96
name: start_playback_for_entry
description: When a flag is set and a table entry is in use, sets a field of the playback state and calls library functions to start playback for that entry.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:15C70
name: find_free_channel_entry
description: Scans four entries of a channel table for one whose field is not the sentinel value, counting those it finds.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:15D4E
name: release_channel_for_entry
description: Looks up the index for an entry and, when one exists, calls an unnamed routine with that index and the entry, then returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:15D8A
name: clear_channel_for_entry
description: Looks up the index for an entry and, when one exists, calls an unnamed routine to clear it, then returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:15DC6
name: combine_two_entry_fields
description: Reads two fields from a table record, combines them through unnamed routine calls, and returns the combined value.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:15E82
name: forward_values_with_global
description: Passes two stored values and a global value to a unnamed routine and stores the result in the frame.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:15EC8
name: notify_call_for_type_eight
description: When the stored value equals eight, calls an unnamed routine with a fixed flag and two stored values, then forwards the result to a second unnamed routine.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:15F0C
name: combine_entry_values_for_index
description: Reads two fields of a table record and combines them through two unnamed routine calls, then returns the result.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:15FFA
name: find_city_by_name_prompt
description: Asks for the name of a city to find, searches the 64-entry city table for a match, and reports an unknown city when none is found.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:1615A
name: count_matching_table_records
description: Walks the table of records and calls unnamed routines for each matching entry, counting the results.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17A5A
name: stub_return_only
description: Consists only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use. It does no work.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17A5C
name: open_display_window
description: Opens an intuition window from the given size and position parameters, stores the window handle in the program's global data, and returns the result.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17AF2
name: open_intuition_screen
description: Stores the screen parameters in global fields and opens a screen through the intuition library.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17B56
name: draw_line_with_pen
description: When a rastport is set, selects a pen colour, moves to a start point and draws a line through the graphics library, then returns a status.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17B8C
name: draw_formatted_text_line
description: Formats a message with the exec formatting call, moves the rastport position, and draws the resulting text with the graphics text call. It returns a pointer to the end of the text.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17BE2
name: store_byte_at_pointer
description: Stores the low byte of a data value at the address held in an address register, then returns.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17BE6
name: set_pen_colors
description: When a rastport is set, sets the foreground and background pen colours through graphics calls and returns the second call's result. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17C08
name: read_byte_at_pointer
description: Reads and returns the byte stored at the address passed in.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17C12
name: allocate_memory_block
description: Allocates a memory block through the exec library and returns a pointer to it, or null when the allocation fails.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17C3E
name: close_window_if_open
description: Clears the window slot in global data and, when a window handle is given, closes that window through intuition.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17C54
name: close_screen_if_open
description: Clears the screen slot in global data and, when a screen handle is given, closes that screen through intuition.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17C6A
name: compare_strings_up_to_length
description: Compares characters of two strings up to a given count and returns minus one when the count runs out or a string ends. The remaining return path is not visible in this code.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17C92
name: find_text_in_bounded_buffer
description: Searches a text buffer forward from a starting position for a pattern limited to a given length, and returns a pointer to the match or null when none is found.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17CCC
name: search_text_backwards
description: Searches a text buffer for a pattern within a bounded length, working from the end of the buffer, and returns the match position or minus one when none is found.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17D16
name: measure_string_length
description: Returns the number of characters before the zero terminator of the string.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17D28
name: read_length_word_before_pointer
description: Returns the 16-bit word stored just before the given address.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17D34
name: allocate_sized_record_block
description: Allocates a memory block through the exec library when the requested size is below a fixed limit, stores the size in the block header, and returns the block or null.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17D7E
name: search_text_with_terminator
description: Searches a text buffer for a pattern like its neighbours, using an extra terminator argument, and returns a pointer to the match or null.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17DBA
name: format_text_with_arguments
description: Formats a string with the exec formatting call, using the caller's arguments and the stored format string, and returns the formatted result.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17E0A
name: write_low_byte_to_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of a data value to the address held in an address register, then returns.

key: 1497 - Five Years After/1497 - Five Years After.adf:1497:0:17E0E
name: parse_signed_decimal_text
description: Parses an optional minus sign and decimal digits from a text string, skipping leading spaces. It returns the number and the position where parsing stopped, and zero when no digits are present.
